title: Parameter Packs (Variadic Generics)
hints: A type parameter pack is written `each T`; a value pack parameter is `repeat each T`.
Iterate the pack with `for v in repeat each value { … }` (Swift 6).
For optionals: parameter `repeat (each T)?`, and return false on the first `nil`.
jsBridge: Parameter packs (`<each T>`) are variadic generics, functions over any number of differently-typed arguments. TS has variadic tuple types (`[...T]`) for the same idea. They're how SwiftUI dropped its 10-view limit.

compass.q: TS `function f<T extends unknown[]>(...args: T)` vs Swift `repeat each T`: what's similar and what isn't?
Can you iterate a pack with a `for` loop? (Pack iteration arrived in Swift 6.0.)
Parameter packs vs `[Any]`: what type information survives?
Would you use packs in app code, or mainly in library and framework APIs?
